intent: Increased sensor size to 0.016 m for better tape coverage and reduced line loss, widened wheel track and body width to 0.16 m to improve turning stability and off-track tolerance, and adjusted sensor positions to maintain full tape coverage. Expect improved line detection, fewer line loss events, and better stability on all tracks, especially slalom.
rationale: The previous geometry with 5 sensors spaced evenly across the front and sensor size 0.012 m performed well on oval and s-bend tracks but struggled on the slalom track, with off-track terminations and higher errors. The integrator feedback suggests increasing sensor size to 0.016 m to improve line coverage and reduce line loss events, and adjusting wheel track and body width to 0.16 m to improve turning stability and off-track tolerance. The telemetry shows line loss events mainly on the slalom track, indicating the need for better edge detection. Therefore, I propose increasing sensor size to 0.016 m, widening the wheel track and body width to 0.16 m, and slightly adjusting sensor positions to maintain coverage across the tape width. This should improve line detection, reduce line loss, and enhance stability during turns, especially on challenging tracks like slalom. I expect fewer line loss events, lower rms and max errors, and improved progress and completion rates.
